name: Plasma Sphere
promptTemplate: A cosmic plasma globe with {{gas_type}} gas, driving {{filament_count}} lightning tendrils with {{energy_level}} agitation and {{touch_mode}} interaction, with outer sphere {{rim_glow}}.

gas_type.hint: Swaps the glowing gas mixture and colour spectrum

energy_level.hint: Turn up for violent, erratic tendril jitter

touch_mode.hint: How the arcs converge and track around the glass

rim_glow.hint: Toggles outer glass sphere glow reflection

listing.blurb: Branching violet lightning filaments crawl from a central electrode to the glass sphere, leaping and converging to the beat as hands touch the perimeter.
listing.prompt: A plasma globe in a dark room: branching violet filaments crawl from a central electrode to the glass, flickering and forking, gathering together on the beat as if a hand had touched the glass. Make it striking on a big projected wall in a dark room: a bold composition, rich colour against real blacks, depth, glow, and motion that reads from across the room. Keep a demoscener's economy: lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, low-resolution offscreen buffers for any per-pixel work, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
